summary: The District continues to face federal control challenges as the Trump administration announces plans for extended National Guard presence in D.C. and signals potential broader federal intervention in city governance. DC Vote and other advocates are opposing what they characterize as attacks on the city's fiscal independence and autonomy, while highlighting how federal management of local affairs remains a live issue affecting D.C. residents.
